item.text: {"winner":"A","confidence":"high","summary":"A is meaningfully preferable, but neither patch satisfies the frozen contract and neither should merge unchanged.","reasons":["A provides stronger contract-focused verification: its Upload test checks the multipart field, filename, content, and an identical replayed body after 429 using content from an os.File.","A’s retry change is narrower: it only rewinds seekable bodies and leaves one-shot readers alone. B eagerly buffers every non-replayable RawClient body, changing global streaming behavior and potentially blocking indefinitely on pipe-like readers.","B ignores errors from io.ReadAll in makeBodyReplayable. After an error, the original request body has already been consumed partially, so the request may be sent truncated without surfacing the source-reader failure.","Both incorrectly declare Upload with a new option type instead of the required opts ...FilesOption, and both call Raw.Do directly rather than routing through FilesService.Add, duplicating its request and response logic."],"risks_a":["Adds prohibited association-field APIs and extends multipart machinery beyond the requested NewFile reuse.","Changes existing option constructor return types and introduces multiple public option interfaces despite the exact API contract.","Refactors RawClient retry behavior despite the explicit scope restriction; wrapping seekable bodies in io.NopCloser also changes source-closing semantics and shares one seeker across replays without synchronization practical for retry but broader-risk API behavior change nonetheless . "],"risks_b":["Buffers all arbitrary RawClient bodies in memory, unexpectedly eliminating streaming across the SDK and risking hangs or excessive memory use.","Silently discards io.ReadAll errors after advancing the source, enabling corrupted requests.","Uses the confusing new AddFileOption API for Upload and duplicates existing Files option concepts with WithAddFileQuery and WithAddFileRequestOptions instead of preserving FilesOption behavior even though this clashes directly with the required signature . Also adds prohibited association fields and does not delegate Upload to Add . "]}
